tools.name: list_color_seasons
tools.description: List the 4 main seasons and 12 sub-seasons of seasonal colour analysis, with a link to each season's page and to a free test for finding your own season. Use when someone doesn't know their season or asks what the seasons are.

tools.name: browse_season
tools.description: A first look at in-stock clothes for one of the 4 main colour seasons (spring, summer, autumn, winter), with links to the shop. For a sub-season such as Soft Autumn, filters or search, use search_clothes.

tools.name: search_clothes
tools.description: Search in-stock clothes, shoes, accessories and makeup for one of the 12 colour seasons with every filter the website has: category, colour, shop, brand, size, material, occasion, style, price and sale. Use for 'what should I wear', 'my colours', or any specific shopping request.

tools.name: second_hand_in_my_season
tools.description: Search second-hand listings in a colour season, with the same filters as search_clothes.
